# Twin Space Studio

> Residential and commercial interior design studio based in Baner, Pune,
> India, serving Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad (PCMC). Full-service design,
> turnkey execution, and styling, typically 10-12 weeks from concept to
> completion.

## Services
- Residential interior design (apartments, villas, bungalows)
- Commercial interior design (offices, retail, commercial spaces)
- Turnkey execution and project management
- Styling and finishing

## Service area
Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad (PCMC), Maharashtra, India

## Indicative pricing
- 2 BHK full home interior: INR 12-16 lakh
- 3 BHK full home interior: INR 16-21 lakh
- Final cost depends on scope, materials and finishes; a transparent
  line-item quote is shared before work begins.
